title: Before class
levelRationale: A short everyday request with an explicitly ordered first action; structural draft only.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 質問と会話を聞いて、答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen to the question and conversation, then choose one answer.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 女の人は、まず何をしますか。
turns.translation: What will the woman do first?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 窓を開けてから、机をふいてください。
turns.translation: Please open the window and then wipe the desks.

options.label: 窓を開けます。
options.rationale: Opening the window precedes wiping the desks.

options.label: 机をふきます。
options.rationale: This is the later action, not the first.

options.label: ドアを閉めます。
options.rationale: Closing the door was not requested.

explanation: The request gives the sequence with 開けてから: opening the window comes first.
